description: This file is a source code for the ManageController class in an ASP.NET Core MVC web application. It manages user account functionalities such as viewing and updating profile information, password management, external login management, two-factor authentication setup, and recovery code handling.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: Controller providing account management endpoints including profile viewing/updating, password change/set, external logins, 2FA, and recovery codes.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display user profile information.

methods.name: MyAccount (POST)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update user profile information such as email and phone number.

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends a verification email to the current user.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the change password page.

methods.name: ChangePassword (POST)
methods.description: Processes password change requests.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Displays the set password page for users without a password.

methods.name: SetPassword (POST)
methods.description: Processes setting a new password for the user.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays current external login providers linked to the user.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates the linking of an external login provider.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Handles the callback after external login linking.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes an external login provider from the user account.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays the 2FA management view.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables two-factor authentication for the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Displays the enable authenticator view.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays recovery codes for 2FA.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Processes enabling the authenticator app for 2FA.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before resetting authenticator app.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets the authenticator key for 2FA reset.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new recovery codes for 2FA.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before generating new recovery codes.
